title: Solution Architect
description:
Location: Kochi
Other locations: Anywhere in Country
Salary: Competitive
Date: 21 Sept 2026
**Job description**
-------------------


Requisition ID: 1739874
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  


**Solution Architect**


**EY Enterprise Technology**

EY Enterprise Technology group specific in the Digital Experience area is working on implementing EY Specific products on the EYDxP powered by Adobe platform that consists of the Adobe CX Stack including but not limited to Adobe Workfront; AEM; AEP; Target; Analytics; AJO.

  


**The opportunity**



The Adobe Platform team is looking for an Architect that is able to assist the Agile Workstream in developing a solution and road maps that meets the business needs. The role will be involved in planning, designing and overseeing the construction of projects and systems. You will be involved in new designs, extensions, and enhancements of feature pertaining to the Adobe platform. The goal of this role is to design a solution that both is functionally and architecturally in the right direction to support the business need but aligns as close as possible to the out of box functionality.

  



The Solution Architect is responsible for the architectural leadership and delivery of architecture for projects working under the direction of the Lead Architect. Makes certain the alignment of the IT Strategy to the broader organization's mission, strategy / objectives, capabilities, and processes using industry recognized architectural models. Expands the company's use of technology as a strategic enabler of goals and objectives, realizing global business benefits whilst empowering local service innovation. Responsible for coordination and delivery of important and complex future planning activities to enable key business service, process, organizational and technology initiatives. They engage directly with business sponsors to conceptualize architectural approaches, develop solution architectures to confirm that the proposed architecture will meet the defined business needs. They validate that the engineering design will satisfy the architectural solution. Guides and mentors’ teams on methodologies, processes and best practices according to EY’s Architecture Frameworks and supports the development and maintenance of these frameworks and approaches, including technical / functional logical modelling, architecture governance, and tooling. Associate directors execute on the maturity plan developed by EA leadership intended to enable delivery of seamless, end\-to\-end Enterprise Architecture Services.

  


**Your key responsibilities**



Day\-to\-day, this role will:


* Aligns and communicates clear architecture plans, driving towards the appropriate balance of cost, risk and quality, and effectively and consistently communicates this to stakeholders
* Works with Architecture team to set architectural direction, builds consensus, mediates conflicts, and helps to create an environment which solicits positive contributions from all participants, including Enterprise Architects, engineering teams, project managers, business analysts, test teams, Information Security and Operations
* Architect solutions that leverage data, analytics, and AI\-driven capabilities (e.g., customer profiles, personalization, and orchestration) while ensuring responsible use, governance, and scalability.
* Enforces architecture governance structures, methodologies (architecture and engineering) and compliance activities to maintain regulatory compliance and enterprise standards
* Communicate feedback to the EA leadership team that helps improve and evolve the quality and type of EA services provided
* Overseas communication of the value and promoting usage and harvesting of EA asset content, it is leveraging via logical frameworks and use in enterprise\-wide road\-mapping
* Develops recommendations regarding enterprise architecture tools and strategies to support the continuing improvement of EA, defining their potential impacts or benefits
* Cultivate and build relationships across business, IT and vendors / analysts to gather intelligence and bring insight into the wider enterprise picture and enable the leveraging of emerging industry standards and approaches within EA
* Develops and implements an ongoing communication plan to educate stakeholders on the purpose and benefits of Solution Architecture
* Strong analytical skills capable of assessing complex business requirements from real world scenarios and the ability to translate them into actionable target architectures, readily understood models and architectural plans
* Deep technical proficiency while the ability to keeping an eye on the bigger picture
* Ability to identify, prioritize and weigh different options, balancing business, cost and technology priorities to determine a best solution
* Strong client\-facing facilitation skills and business acumen needed to help business leaders and program managers understand how to apply complex IT / Architecture concepts to solve business problems
* Contributing to and driving global technology standards proposals and filing exceptions as required
* Provides thought leadership into the evolution of the Solution Architecture function, working collaboratively with managers, peers and analysts
* Directs and provides guidance and thought leadership to an Architecture team so that architectural assets, concepts and solutions are built in line with Enterprise Architecture principles
* Drives the creation of relevant and meaningful solution architectures, re\-usable assets and other deliverables that enables the overall business thus driving better performance
* Manages the solution architecture for their program and is accountable for maturing its architectural linkages across the other Enterprise Architecture frameworks

  


**Skills and attributes for success**



To be successful in this role, candidates should possess the following core skills:


* Directs a virtual Architecture team to align with overall Enterprise Architecture objectives
* Deep Adobe CX Stack expertise
* Strong analytical skills
* Good leadership skills coupled with exceptional judgment and tact.
* Strong expertise in industry standard Enterprise and Solution Architecture Frameworks and Governance
* Ability to translate business needs into Solution Architecture requirements, and estimate the financial and architectural impact of alternatives
* Ability to rapidly comprehend the changes to key business processes and the impact on the overall architecture
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Attention to detail and strong organizational skills
* Ability to manage multiple tasks/projects in a fast\-paced environment
* Ability to work effectively with clients and team members across multiple geographies
* Good relationship building, facilitation and influencing skills and experience of leveraging these on both ITS and business leadership contexts
* Flexibility to adjust to multiple demands, shifting priorities, ambiguity, and rapid change

  


**To qualify for the role, you must have**


* Bachelor’s Degree (required) or equivalent work experience.
* 5\+ years of experience in Adobe Product family as a Solution Architect
* Enterprise scale Adobe Implementation experience
* Strong understanding of digital experience platforms
* Strong conflict resolution and negotiation skills
* Strong verbal, presentation and written communication skills
* Knowledge of current digital marketing trends and best practices on topics such as personalization, cross channel marketing, mobile, data driven optimization of experiences
* Innovative thinker and desire to help us build out a new Consulting practice and be a pioneer within the industry.
* Self\-motivated and able to work with minimal direction.
* Other relevant experience in a related technical field (application development, deployment/implementation and infrastructure)
* Work experience in a professional services industry, or global teams preferred
* Significant work experience IT infrastructure and security projects
* Flexibility to work outside typical hours, as required of a global team
* Flexibility to travel on a very limited basis

  


**Ideally, you’ll also have**


* Adobe certifications \- Desired
* Familiarity with ITIL
* Experience in supporting a professional service and/or global IT organization
* An understanding of Information Security tenets and priorities
* Familiarity with the IIBA (BABOK) Practice Standards
* Enterprise Search Implementation Experience – Desired.

  


**EY \| Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

  

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

  


Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: ET BMC - MarTech Solution Architect
description:
Location: Kochi
Other locations: Anywhere in Country
Salary: Competitive
Date: 17 Sept 2026
**Job description**
-------------------


Requisition ID: 1744704
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  


**Discipline:** Brand, Marketing and Communications (BMC)


**Role Type:** ET BMC \- MarTech Solution Architect

  


**The opportunity**



The BMC MarTech Solution Architect plays a pivotal role in defining and enabling the future of BMC's digital, data and marketing technology ecosystem. This role is part of the Enterprise Technology CBS Solutions Delivery Team and partners closely with Product Managers in Technology Enablement and cross\-functional business teams such as Clients \& Industries (C\&I), Talent, Alumni and Communications.



The architect is responsible for translating business strategy into target\-state architecture, defining the practical transition states required to reach it, and helping leadership and Product Managers convert that direction into prioritized, executable delivery roadmaps. The role brings together business, application, data, integration and technology perspectives to guide investment decisions and enable a scalable, data\-driven and AI\-enabled future.



The role will also shape the future architecture of BMC's AI\-enabled MarTech ecosystem, defining how enterprise platforms, data, AI agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP) services and emerging technologies work together securely and at scale to deliver business value.

  


**Your key responsibilities**


* Own and maintain the BMC MarTech architecture strategy, vision and target\-state architecture.
* Develop future\-state business, capability, application, data, integration and technology architectures aligned to business priorities and enterprise standards.
* Assess the current landscape and define transition\-state architectures, capability increments and migration approaches required to reach the target state.
* Partner with Product Managers and business leaders to translate architecture into phased multi\-year delivery roadmaps, investment plans and measurable business outcomes.
* Identify cross\-product dependencies, sequencing requirements, constraints, technical debt and transformation risks, and ensure these are reflected in delivery planning.
* Produce capability maps, architecture blueprints, heat maps, maturity assessments, integration views and transformation roadmaps that support clear decision\-making.
* Translate strategic business needs into end\-to\-end solution options and recommendations, including benefits, costs, risks, compliance, technical debt and long\-term sustainability.
* Advise senior leadership on technology strategy, platform evolution, investment priorities, sourcing choices and the implications of architecture decisions.
* Define and maintain MarTech architectural principles, standards, reusable patterns and reference architectures.
* Define architectural patterns for AI agents, agent orchestration, MCP\-enabled integrations and emerging digital worker capabilities across the MarTech ecosystem.
* Assess emerging technologies, including agentic AI, MCP frameworks, orchestration platforms and autonomous workflow capabilities, and determine their applicability to BMC business outcomes.
* Define the governance, security, identity, observability and interoperability patterns required to support AI\-enabled products and services at enterprise scale.
* Act as the architectural connector across BMC, ET, C\&I, Talent, Alumni and Communications, ensuring alignment across products, programmes and business functions.
* Reduce duplication and complexity by promoting reuse of enterprise platforms, shared capabilities, common data and agreed standards.
* Collaborate with Data Architecture teams to define AI\-ready data models, taxonomies, metadata structures and information flows.
* Ensure MarTech platforms integrate effectively with enterprise data lakes, CDPs, analytics platforms, identity services and consent capabilities.
* Assess emerging technologies and evaluate platform and vendor options with Product Management teams.
* Support business cases, portfolio prioritisation, design assurance and enterprise governance forums.
* Promote API\-first, event\-driven, modular and composable architecture principles.
* Champion security, privacy, accessibility, performance, resilience, observability and global scalability throughout the product lifecycle.
* Communicate complex architectural concepts and trade\-offs in clear, business\-focused language for executive, product and delivery audiences.
* Serve as a trusted advisor on MarTech strategy, transformation, innovation and platform evolution.

  


**Skills and attributes for success**


* Deep knowledge of MarTech ecosystems, including CRM, CDP, CMS, DAM, marketing automation, analytics, identity and consent.
* Strong architecture modelling capabilities across business, capability, data, application, integration and technology domains.
* Proven experience producing current\-state assessments, target\-state architectures, transition\-state designs and migration strategies.
* Experience developing multi\-year transformation roadmaps and working with Product Managers to convert architectural direction into sequenced delivery plans.
* Ability to translate executive objectives and business outcomes into actionable architecture, investment priorities and delivery roadmaps.
* Experience leading architecture across complex transformation programmes involving multiple platforms, products and business functions.
* Knowledge of emerging AI architecture patterns, including agentic systems, Model Context Protocol (MCP), orchestration frameworks, retrieval architectures and AI governance.
* Experience evaluating emerging technologies and translating innovation opportunities into pragmatic architecture and product roadmaps.
* Strong commercial and strategic thinking, with experience supporting business cases, option assessments, vendor evaluations and investment decisions.
* Experience designing integrations across multiple enterprise platforms and data ecosystems.
* Strong understanding of enterprise data strategy, data governance, privacy, security and AI enablement.
* Excellent communication, leadership, facilitation and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to influence senior leaders.
* Architecture certification such as TOGAF, ArchiMate or equivalent, with relevant cloud certification desirable.
* Experience with Adobe Experience Cloud, MS Dynamics, CDPs, DAM or comparable enterprise platforms.

  


**Typical architecture outputs**


* Current\-state and target\-state architecture views.
* Transition\-state architecture and migration approaches.
* Business capability maps, maturity assessments and heat maps.
* Multi\-year architecture and technology transformation roadmaps.
* Solution blueprints, integration architectures and data flow models.
* AI agent, orchestration and MCP\-enabled integration architecture patterns.
* Architecture principles, standards, reusable patterns and reference architectures.
* Solution option assessments, architecture decision records and investment recommendations.
* Dependency, risk, technical debt and sequencing views that support portfolio and product planning.

  


**Technologies and Tools**


* MarTech and AdTech platforms, including Adobe and demand\-side platforms.
* CDP, CMS, CRM, DAM, marketing automation and analytics platforms, including Adobe, MS Dynamics and Microsoft Azure ecosystems.
* AI and agentic platforms, orchestration frameworks, retrieval services and enterprise knowledge platforms.
* MCP\-enabled integration patterns and services.
* API\-led, ESB, event\-driven and composable integration approaches.
* Cloud platforms, including Azure, AWS and GCP.
* Architecture and modelling tools, including LeanIX, ArchiMate and Lucidchart.

  


**What we offer**



We offer the opportunity to shape the future of BMC’s enterprise technology landscape, with significant influence across ET, C\&I, Talent, Alumni, and Communications. You will collaborate with global teams, drive architectural standards, and help build an AI\-enabled future through strong partnership with Data Architecture.


* **Continuous learning:** You will develop the skills and capabilities needed to thrive in a rapidly evolving digital and AI environment.
* **Success, as defined by you:** We empower you with tools, flexibility, and support to make a meaningful impact.
* **Transformative leadership:** You’ll receive coaching, enablement, and opportunities to lead strategic technology decisions that impact the global organisation.
* **Diverse and inclusive culture:** You’ll be valued for your perspective and empowered to help shape a culture of innovation and inclusion.

  


**EY \| Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

  

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

  


Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: IT Architect – Windows & Datacenter
description:
**Experience:** 10\+ Years preferred

**Availability:** Immediate / 1 month Notice Period

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a senior Microsoft Infrastructure Technical Architect with strong hands\-on expertise across enterprise Windows infrastructure, Active Directory, IIS, Microsoft SQL Server, Exchange Server, SCCM, Hyper\-V, VMware and associated datacenter technologies.

The role requires deep technical experience in designing, implementing, migrating, upgrading and troubleshooting mission\-critical on\-premise Microsoft infrastructure environments. The ideal candidate should have prior experience working with banking or financial\-services organizations in India, GCC or other international markets and be comfortable operating within highly controlled, security\-sensitive production environments.

This is a hands\-on architecture and delivery role and is best suited for candidates who have personally executed complex infrastructure migrations, upgrades, security implementations and DR projects.

**Key Responsibilities**

\* Design, assess and implement enterprise Microsoft infrastructure solutions across Production, DR, UAT and Test environments.

\* Lead Windows Server installation, configuration, migration and upgrades, including Windows Server 2012/2016/2019/2022/2025 environments.

\* Perform infrastructure discovery, compatibility assessment, dependency mapping and migration planning.

\* Architect, administer and troubleshoot Active Directory, including Domain Controllers, DNS, DHCP, Group Policies, replication, FSMO roles, service accounts, authentication and security hardening.

\* Design, implement, migrate and troubleshoot Microsoft IIS environments supporting enterprise applications.

\* Support Microsoft SQL Server infrastructure, including installation, configuration, migration, upgrade, security, backup/recovery and high\-availability requirements.

\* Implement and support Microsoft Exchange Server environments, including migration, DAG and hybrid scenarios.

\* Manage and troubleshoot SCCM / Microsoft Configuration Manager for server and endpoint administration, patching and software deployment.

\* Design and support virtualization environments using Hyper\-V and VMware vSphere/ESXi.

\* Plan and execute OS migrations, application server migrations and infrastructure modernization projects.

\* Support application teams during platform migration, middleware upgrade and production cutover activities.

\* Design and implement Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity solutions, including replication, failover, recovery testing and DR drills.

\* Implement Windows infrastructure security controls including hardening, patching, vulnerability remediation, firewall policies, access controls, certificates and security baselines.

\* Troubleshoot complex issues spanning Windows OS, Active Directory, networking, firewalls, DNS, load balancers, databases, middleware and applications.

\* Prepare migration runbooks, rollback procedures, architecture documents, implementation procedures and operational handover documentation.

\* Participate in CAB/change\-management processes and execute controlled production cutovers.

\* Provide technical leadership to infrastructure engineers, application teams, security teams and third\-party vendors.

Mandatory Technical Skills

**Strong hands\-on expertise in:**

\* Microsoft Windows Server

\* Active Directory Domain Services

\* DNS, DHCP and Group Policy

\* Microsoft IIS

\* Microsoft SQL Server

\* Microsoft Exchange Server

\* SCCM / Microsoft Configuration Manager

\* Hyper\-V

\* VMware vSphere / ESXi

\* Windows Server migration and upgrade

\* Application migration support

\* Datacenter infrastructure

\* Networking fundamentals

\* Enterprise firewall concepts

\* Disaster Recovery implementation

\* Backup and restoration

\* High Availability

\* Windows security hardening

\* Patch and vulnerability management

\* PowerShell administration and automation

\* Production cutover and rollback planning

Banking / Enterprise Experience

Candidates must have prior hands\-on experience delivering infrastructure projects within banks, financial institutions or similarly regulated enterprise environments.

**Experience should ideally include areas such as:**

\* Production infrastructure migration

\* Datacenter modernization

\* Windows Server upgrades

\* Active Directory migration or upgrade

\* Application and database platform migration

\* DR implementation and testing

\* Security hardening

\* Vulnerability remediation

\* High\-availability infrastructure

\* Change/CAB\-controlled production environments

**Preferred / Additional Skills**

**Knowledge or hands\-on experience with the following will be an advantage:**

\* Microsoft Defender for Endpoint / Defender for Cloud

\* Microsoft 365

\* Microsoft Intune

\* Microsoft Entra ID

\* Microsoft Sentinel

\* Microsoft Azure

\* Azure Arc

\* Azure Monitor

\* Azure Site Recovery

\* Hybrid Active Directory

\* Identity and Access Management

\* Zero Trust security architecture

\* Microsoft cloud security technologies

**Certification Requirements**

Candidates must possess relevant Microsoft infrastructure certifications, preferably covering Windows Server, hybrid infrastructure, identity or Microsoft enterprise technologies.

**Additional certifications in any of the following will be advantageous:**

\* Microsoft Azure

\* Microsoft Security

\* VMware

\* ITIL

\* Cybersecurity

\* Networking

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

\* 10\+ years of overall infrastructure experience, with significant hands\-on Microsoft platform expertise.

\* Strong architectural capability combined with current hands\-on engineering skills.

\* Demonstrated experience independently executing complex infrastructure migrations and upgrades.

\* Strong troubleshooting skills across OS, network, security, virtualization, database and middleware layers.

\* Experience working in regulated enterprise or banking environments.

\* Comfortable working onsite and coordinating with customer infrastructure, application, database, security and network teams.

\* Strong technical documentation and stakeholder communication skills.

\* Ability to lead technical discussions, solution reviews, migration planning and production cutovers.

\* Candidates currently available in Oman or willing to relocate/deploy onsite to Oman for the contract period will be preferred.

**Engagement**

This is a 12\-month onsite contract engagement in Oman requiring close coordination with customer infrastructure, application, security and operations teams.

Candidates with immediate or short\-notice availability are preferred. Agencies holding matching candidates can also connect.

Pay: ₹150,000\.00 \- ₹250,000\.00 per month

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Kochi, Kerala
